_comment: How to read this template. Every field is optional; see proposal-templates/README.md. Written per template because the parser cannot tell a reusable photograph from a diagram captioned with the previous client's name — both are a JPEG with an alt attribute.
_images: Matched against alt text, case-insensitively. assignmentSpecific images are removed with their frame; rebuildAsText ones are replaced by cards the drafter fills, because they are a picture of a page rather than a picture.
